title: About Me
description: Meet Erkan — a QA engineer bridging Web2 and Web3 testing worlds with practical insights, real-world examples, and a focus on making blockchain technology more secure and reliable.

body.raw:
### 👋 About Me

Hey, I'm **Erkan** — a QA engineer who's been working in tech and **blockchain** for quite a while now.  
Over the years, I've tested everything from traditional web systems to decentralized apps, wallets, and smart contracts.

I created **web3qa.com** to share what I've learned about **testing blockchain technologies in the real world** — focusing on reproducible results, practical examples, and clarity over hype.  
My goal is simple: help testers, auditors, and developers make Web3 **more secure, reliable, and transparent** — one verified test case at a time.

---

### 🔗 Connect
You can find me on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/erkan-barin/) — always happy to connect with other QA engineers and blockchain enthusiasts.
